heading: Built to be trusted, not just used
subheading: Most online calculators show a single vague number. We show the reasoning.

cards.title: Modular, transparent pricing engine
cards.description: Every estimate is built from configurable country, city, brand, and procedure pricing — never a single hardcoded number.

cards.title: We show our work
cards.description: Every result includes a plain-language explanation of exactly which inputs drove each line item in your estimate.

cards.title: Your data stays yours
cards.description: Your answers are saved locally in your browser. Nothing is sent anywhere unless you choose to unlock your PDF report.

cards.title: No obligation, ever
cards.description: This is an independent estimating tool, not a lead funnel for a single clinic. Use it purely to plan and compare.
